title: Bad Casette - Datapack
description: Adds a Bad Piggies cassette tape to Minecraft Vista Mod
body:
Adds a Bad Piggies cassette tape to the Minecraft Vista Mod, letting you play Bad Piggies music on your in-game TV! (Data Pack Version)

**Requires** 

- [Bad Piggies Cassette Tape (Resourcepack)](https://modrinth.com/project/RRXstCVQ)


- [Vista Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/vista_tv)
